## What and why / 改动与原因

Describe the player/developer problem and the smallest change that solves it.

## Validation / 验证

- [ ] `dart format --output=none --set-exit-if-changed lib test scripts`
- [ ] `flutter analyze lib`
- [ ] Relevant tests pass; add a regression test for changed behavior.
- [ ] Document platform checks performed, if applicable.

## Boundaries / 边界

- [ ] No new cross-game dependencies or UI imports in data kernels.
- [ ] Convenience plugins remain in approved adapters.
- [ ] 新增或修改的说明性代码注释使用中文。
- [ ] Screenshots and logs contain no sensitive information.

## Evidence / 结果

Attach focused screenshots, test output, or before/after measurements where useful. Do not claim untested platform support.
